contracts.goal: Preserve exact Manual Resolution identity across fold/browse/reload and finish the active resolution without silently auto-starting the next stack entry.
requiredFacts: Two spells form canonical response stack B/A.
B enters entry-bound Manual Resolution and exposes its exact resolution identity.
Folding/browsing preserves B and returns to the same resolution.
Reload/reconnect reconstructs the same Resolution B.
Finishing B leaves A pending and does not auto-start A.
Page errors and unexpected console errors remain zero.
contracts.legacyRetirementPrecondition: The current execution path for this contract is active and verified before legacy R3.1 browser evidence is retired.

contracts.goal: Preserve browser composition for Formal operations that are covered at lower layers but not by the O4P production journey.
requiredFacts: A legal graveyard card is selected through visible UI and the committed cast preserves sourceZone=graveyard.
The selected discard additional cost is included in the same cast operation; final state shows the spell on the stack and the cost card in the graveyard.
Visible turn-face-up action emits special.turnFaceUp for the selected card ID and the resulting card state is face up.
Browser console errors and warnings remain zero.
contracts.legacyRetirementPrecondition: A current non-legacy execution path for this contract is active and verified before the old R4 browser workflow shell is retired.

contracts.goal: Preserve the cross-layer two-seat Cockpit turn/draw/cleanup/reload behavior that split unit/component tests do not by themselves compose.
requiredFacts: The first player skips the first turn draw in the two-player start.
Subsequent ordinary draw occurs exactly once.
Reload during draw does not repeat the turn-based action.
A permanent untaps on the correct next turn.
Mana clears and temporary modifiers expire at the required boundary.
Cleanup modal blocks keyboard turn advance while unresolved; required discards selected through the modal complete and reduce the active hand to its maximum size.
Turn increments exactly once after cleanup.
Page errors and unexpected console errors remain zero.
contracts.legacyRetirementPrecondition: The current contract execution path is registered and verified before historical turn/cleanup workflow or branch evidence is retired.
